members.english: qiān: lead (metal) · yán: in 铅山 (Yánshān, a place name)
to temper, to refine; to forge metal
to fuse, to melt; to market, to sell
to trample, to tread on, to walk over
to injure, to ruin, to spoil; cruel, oppressive, savage; disabled, incomplete

comparisons.note: 钱 and 钟 both use 钅 on the left. Compare 戋 in 钱 with 中 in 钟.
钱 and 线 both use 戋 on the right. Compare 钅 in 钱 with 纟 in 线.
Both have a reading qián. Compare 钱 (money) and 前 (before / in front of).
